text:
maya_cs: quick check-in with @customer-poc-sunn — getting ready for private/VPC go-live next week. top blockers: audit log delivery, KMS key access, IAM cross-account role, and egress firewall rules. can ops confirm status?
liam_se: network: customer added SG but traffic to our ingress LB still drops. asked them to allow our egress IPs (54.23.11.5/32, 54.23.12.0/24) and outbound 443. theyll push change in staging now.
customer-poc-sunn: pushed ACL change to staging. running curl tests to health endpoint, saw 502 earlier. will update.
ops-bot: deploy-checker: staging connectivity test 1/3 — failed (502). log: `curl -v https://private-ingress.redwood.svc/health` -> TLS handshake timed out.
liam_se: 502/TLS handshake usually firewall or SNI/proxy. @customer-poc-sunn can you share VPC NAT route table and any proxy in front?
maya_cs: KMS: rachel mentioned key policy needs explicit cross-account statement so our service role can Decrypt for telemetry ingestion. blocking audit log delivery to Splunk HEC.
rachel_security: KMS: include Redwood service principal in key policy; avoid Deny on encryption-context. sample snippet to send their team.
devops_tom: IAM: prefer cross-account role with least-privilege. trust policy example and scope permissions to the KMS key ARN.
customer-poc-sunn: for audit logs, what ports/IPs should we open for Splunk HEC?
maya_cs: Splunk HEC default 8088/TCP (or 6514 for TLS syslog). well provide final IPs list.
liam_se: packet capture shows SYNs reach NAT, SYN-ACK dropped before TLS handshake. suggests stateful firewall or SSL inspection. please check connection tracking and any proxy boxes.
maya_cs: enablement: 30-min walkthrough of observability and alert wiring scheduled Wed 10:30 PT. ok?
customer-poc-sunn: Wed works. please cover token rotation and KMS rollover plan for our security reviewers.
rachel_security: will cover key rotation, policy ACLs, and recommend immutable retention: dedicated S3 with object lock then forward to Splunk.
maya_cs: flagged moderate renewal risk: concerns about cost spikes and missing logs. if ingestion isnt stable by onboarding deadline, escalate renewal owner.
devops_tom: mitigation: enable prefix caching to reduce duplicate token cost; PS to suggest quantization/batching.
maya_cs: action items: 1) @customer-poc-sunn share NAT route table & any SSL inspection boxes (due EOD) 2) @rachel_security send KMS policy doc (due tomorrow) 3) @liam_se validate egress IP list & confirm ports (due EOD) 4) @devops_tom share cross-account role & minimal policy (done) 5) schedule Wed 10:30 PT walkthrough (maya to send invite).
liam_se: Ill run a packet trace after their ACL push and post results.
customer-poc-sunn: pushing NAT/ACL updates now and will follow up. thanks for the walkthrough :pray:
maya_cs: thanks all — react with :thumbsup: when your item is updated. Ill update the onboarding risk board after the walkthrough.
